subject: english
stem: Which revision removes the ambiguity in 'When Amy met Zoe, she laughed'?
options: When Amy met Zoe, she laughed loudly.
She laughed when she met her.
When Amy met Zoe, Amy laughed.

optionRationales.reason: When Amy met Zoe, she laughed loudly.：副詞未消除 she 的兩個候選。
She laughed when she met her.：增加更多歧義代名詞。
When they met, she laughed.：they 與 she 仍未定位個人。
When Amy met Zoe, Amy laughed.：重複姓名明確指定笑的人。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「利用人稱、數、性別、語法角色與語意相容性，找出代名詞唯一且最近的合理先行詞。」可推出 When Amy met Zoe, Amy laughed.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 When Amy met Zoe, Amy laughed. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
